author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as a mortar-and-pestle blob: the crossed fingers were a thick Y and the palm a bowl, with no thumb. Redrawn on VRECT_L: index (front) and middle (back) fingers on mirrored 1:2 bands with r5 tips, crossing so the back finger hides behind the front one, the curled fingers as a rounded knuckle at the right, the folded thumb as a pill across the palm with an open lower edge, and a U palm. Reads as crossed fingers at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The two curled fingers are merged into one knuckle shoulder (no room for a divider at 8-unit spacing); the middle finger's lower part merges into the palm.
